thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging taylor-oncall (SRE) — elevated 5xx & timeouts from inference-gateway across us-west-2. Alert: 502/504 spike + latency. (auto-created)

taylor-oncall: grabbing it. can anyone confirm customer-facing impact? sla alerts firing.

samir-eng-sre: seeing a lot of 502s from gateway -> envoy upstream failures. spike started ~10:35 UTC. histogram shows backend p50 fine but p95/p99 dramatic.

elaine-eng-runtime: trending shows increased retries and host ejections on the lb pool for inference-dedicated nodes. Envoy stats: `cluster.inference_backend.upstream_rq_5xx: 4200`, `cluster.inference_backend.upstream_rq_timeouts: 1100`, host ejections = 12/20.

ryan-product: we have two enterprise customers reporting errors in production chat flows. maria-cs, flagging you for customer comms.

maria-cs: yep receiving the messages, just told customers we're investigating. waiting on impact window + ETA to rollback.

samir-eng-sre: quick dump of what I'm seeing (k, short):
```
# envoy cluster stats (snippet)
cluster.inference_backend.upstream_rq_5xx: 4218
cluster.inference_backend.upstream_rq_timeouts: 1124
cluster.inference_backend.upstream_rq_pending_overflow: 0
cluster.inference_backend.upstream_cx_total: 20234
cluster.inference_backend.upstream_cx_active: 18
server.info: v1.22.1
```

elaine-eng-runtime: checking recent config changes — there was a rollout at 10:30 for `gw-route-v2` that adjusted route weights and enabled `retry_on: 5xx,gateway-error` on the ingress gateway (intended for transient infra errors).

taylor-oncall: @samir please check host ejection reason and if circuit-breaker thresholds changed. @elaine can you paste the rollout PR link?

samir-eng-sre: host ejections are due to consecutive 5xx (type: consecutive_5xx) — threshold now 3 instead of 5 after yesterday's tuning. That combined with aggressive retries is amplifying failures.

elaine-eng-runtime: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/rollouts/3472 — we lowered cb threshold and added per-route retries. I think the combination is the root cause.

ryan-product: so the sequence is: route rollout -> lower cb thresholds -> retries -> ejected hosts -> more 5xx for remaining hosts -> cascading 502s/504s?

taylor-oncall: yup. looks like a classic retry amplification + circuit-breaker tightness. need live mitigation: revert retry change or disable retries at gateway, and temporarily increase cb threshold to reduce ejections.

samir-eng-sre: mitigation steps I propose (short):
1) disable `retry_on` at gateway (quick patch)
2) revert cb threshold to previous value (5 -> 10 consecutive_5xx)
3) bounce traffic away from recently drained hosts (manual weight change)
4) monitor errors for 5-10m

taylor-oncall: do 1 & 2 in parallel. @deploy-bot can you patch the config?

deploy-bot: triggered rollout: `infra/gateway-config@revert-retries-1755551234` — starting canary. logs: `deploy: started`, canary on 2 pods.

elaine-eng-runtime: patching circuit breaker values via envoy config map: `kubectl patch cm envoy-clusters -n infra --patch '{"data":{"inference_backend_circuit_threshold":"10"}}'` — applying now.

samir-eng-sre: manually adjusted weights on the LB: set `inference-backend-zoneb` weight to 0.2 (was 0.6) to reduce pressure on that shard which had mass ejections.

maria-cs: customers asking ETA. what's our target for first baseline recovery?

taylor-oncall: give us 10 minutes after both patches complete. if we see error rate fall < 2% of baseline and p95 latency stable, we tell customers "partial mitigation in progress".

deploy-bot: canary finished — `deploy: success` — rollout ID 9223.

samir-eng-sre: initial metrics: upstream 5xx dropped ~65% in last 6m. upstream timeouts down 70%. host ejections stopped.

elaine-eng-runtime: monitoring dashboard:
- request rate returned to normal
- p95 latency back within 15% of baseline
- 5xx still slightly elevated in us-west-2 (about 0.8% of requests)

ryan-product: great. I'll update status page with "mitigation applied, monitoring for stability".

maria-cs: sending interim note to affected customers: "We've applied a mitigation to our gateway routing configs to reduce elevated errors; we're monitoring and will update within 30 minutes."

samir-eng-sre: followups/next steps (to-do):
- re-evaluate proper retry policy: probably allow `retry_on` only for idempotent calls and with per-attempt timeouts
- add a short cooldown before host ejection to avoid rapid cascade
- add automated guard: disallow simultaneous CB tightening + enabling retries in same rollout
- write post-incident runbook entry and link PRs/metrics

taylor-oncall: recording incident for postmortem. severity: S2 (customer impact limited, mitigated quickly). tagging owners: @elaine for config rollback PR, @samir for runbook/alerts tuning, @ryan for customer comms.

elaine-eng-runtime: creating rollback PR to remove per-route retry_on and revert the cb change if needed. PR link will be posted here once created.

deploy-bot: Note: automatic paging rules kicked in at 10:36 UTC -> oncall notified.

maria-cs: I'll follow up with customers once we have 30m stable window. thanks team. :thumbsup:

samir-eng-sre: quick snippet for runbook draft to avoid this repeating:
```
Symptoms: sudden spike in 502/504 when gateway retried and CB thresholds tight.
Immediate mitigation: disable retries at ingress, raise CB threshold, shift traffic away from ejected hosts.
Long term: circuit cooldown, retry scoping, rollout gating.
```

taylor-oncall: closing live paging. keep monitoring, postmortem by EOD. thx all. :white_check_mark:
